channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: FDA approves mFlusiva, the first mRNA influenza vaccine
item.description: The FLUENT trial showed 26.6% relative efficacy over a standard-dose vaccine in adults 50 and older, leading to FDA approval.

item.title: Many patients may not fully understand lab results via portals
item.description: A large cross-sectional study found that patients viewing test results online often have limited comprehension, highlighting potential gaps in patient understanding.

item.title: Review examines next-generation drug delivery for oral cancer
item.description: Researchers from Indonesia, Japan, and China, led by Professor Nurhasni Hasan, review advanced drug delivery systems for oral cancer treatment.

item.title: Common lipid-lowering drug may reduce diabetic eye damage
item.description: A common lipid-lowering drug is associated with significantly lower risks of vision-threatening retinopathy, cataracts, and macular edema in patients with mild or moderate diabetes.
